entity.name: Memphis Yomael Núñez Cruz
entity.description: Maintainer of YotsubaShader, an open-source C# shader authoring framework and compiler infrastructure project. The project is developed publicly under the Microsoft Public License and aims to let engine and framework developers describe shaders in C# using familiar HLSL, GLSL, MSL, SPIR-V, or WGSL-inspired vocabularies.

projects.name: YotsubaShader
projects.description: YotsubaShader is an open-source shader authoring framework and compiler infrastructure project for .NET. Its repository contains five C# authoring vocabularies, Roslyn-based shader discovery and semantic processing, a backend-neutral intermediate representation, SPIR-V module construction, and a browser-based documentation and analysis playground. The complete C# to IR to GPU binary pipeline remains under active development.
